summary: Execute planner task T-120 by extracting the existing Python AST logic into one shared source-map primitive and adding exact provenance-preserving bounded source navigation with noncanonical content-addressed caches.

candidates.rationale: Create one shared Python source-map primitive and a bounded exact-source navigator with hash-keyed derived cache, ambiguity handling, and exact-region fallback.
Reuse the extracted source-map primitive for symbol profiling instead of maintaining a competing AST parser.
Integrate source navigation into entrypoints, CLI discovery, policy documentation, and verification scope.

applied_changes.description: Added shared Python source maps and source navigation with Git/hash provenance, content-addressed versioned cache, exact symbol/region selection, ambiguity detection, and fail-closed semantic mapping.
Token symbol profiling now consumes the shared source-map primitive.
Integrated source navigation policy/tool into workspace, CLI, docs, and full-regression classification.
